name: SMA Crossover Trend Following — CL Crude Oil (4H)
description: Long-only trend-following strategy on CL (WTI Crude Oil) continuous futures using 4-hour bars. Goes long when the 50-period SMA crosses above the 200-period SMA, exits when the 50-period SMA crosses below. Uses BackwardPanamaCanal adjustment with FirstOfMonth rollover. Fixed 1-contract position sizing per signal.
source:
# SMA Crossover Trend Following — CL Crude Oil (4H)
# 50/200 SMA crossover on 4-hour continuation-adjusted prices
# Long when fast SMA > slow SMA, flat otherwise
# Single asset: CL (WTI Crude Oil) futures, 1 contract per trade

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=4H)()

# Continuation series (BackwardPanamaCanal + FirstOfMonth)
cont = futures_continuation(timeframe=4H, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# --- Signal Logic ---
# Fast (50-period) and Slow (200-period) SMA on 4H bars
fast_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Trend state: bullish when fast > slow, bearish when fast < slow
is_bullish = fast_sma > slow_sma
is_bearish = fast_sma < slow_sma

# Hold long position from golden cross until death cross
held = hold_until()(enter=is_bullish, exit=is_bearish)

# --- Execution ---
# Contract selection for futures rollover
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)

# Long-only: enter on bullish state, no short positions
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Fixed 1 contract per trade
position_size(type=SizeType.unit)(size=1)
